entry.title: New: dsh-mermaid-render
entry.summary: Mermaid diagram renderer for the Web UI conversation: renders mermaid code blocks into interactive cards (zoom, fit-width, fullscreen viewer, preview/code toggle) with official UI primitives, and keeps the original code block with an inline error banner when rendering fails. Exact install spec: github:genius-alray/dsh-mermaid-render. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
